creators: José Manuel Pérez de la Lastra
description: Snakemake workflow for the structural annotation of a chromosome-level genome assembly by homology transfer and ab initio prediction, with evaluation against an external reference. Generates four proteome sets and a combined candidate reference proteome for Lama glama. The workflow covers Liftoff, miniprot, proteome extraction and BUSCO; LiftOn, Helixer, InterProScan and DIAMOND were run manually, with the commands documented in the repository.
name: llama-annotation-pipeline
